name: The Duke of Death and His Maid
description: Due to a childhood curse, anything that the Duke touches will die - which makes his flirty maid’s behavior all the more shocking! Can the Duke and his companions break the curse, or is he doomed to a life where love is forever out of his reach?

The Duke and Alice
videos.overview: A teenage boy lives deep in the forest, far away from his family and cursed to kill anything he touches. His maid, Alice, is constantly teasing him and getting far too close for comfort…

videos.title: The Duke, His Butler, and a Lost Cat
videos.overview: Having recovered from a back injury, the Duke's elderly butler Rob resumes his post. But while his work is flawless, some of his five senses aren't quite up to snuff. Meanwhile, a couple of unexpected guests pay a visit to the Duke's mansion…

videos.title: The Duke and the Meteor Shower During the Full Moon
videos.overview: After losing a bet to Alice, the Duke agrees to take her to the town’s masquerade festival. But the two get separated when the Duke, clad in a clunky, steel costume to protect others from his touch of death, gets carried away by the crowd…

videos.title: The Duke, Alice, and Memories of Snow
videos.overview: When Alice loses one of her mother’s earrings in the snow, the Duke goes out into the cold, dark night to look for it. Meanwhile, a lost witch finds the Duke lying unconscious in the snow and decides to help him. Does she know how to break his curse?

videos.title: The Duke, a Crow, and Ice Skating
videos.overview: As the Duke recovers from a fall and a hit on the head while out ice skating with Alice, he encounters a talking white crow. He thinks he may be imagining things, but then he learns that the crow happens to be searching for a lost witch named Cuff...

videos.title: The Duke, Alice, and a Night in the Witches' World
videos.overview: The night of the blood moon has arrived, and Cuff and Zain show up at the Duke’s mansion to take him to the witches’ sabbath. What will he do if he finds the witch that cursed him there?

videos.title: The Duke's and Alice's Uneventful Day
videos.overview: With the witches' sabbath over and the Duke no closer to ridding himself of his curse, he and Alice spend the day trying out various enchanted items to break the curse, with hilarious results…

videos.title: White Snow, Black Clothes
videos.overview: On a snowstormy night, Alice is reminded of when she first began working as the Duke's maid. Despondent and holed up in his dark, messy room, the Duke can't even remember who Alice is and is ready to dismiss her. How will she get him to open his heart?

videos.title: The Duke, Alice, and the Christmas Eve Vow
videos.overview: It’s Christmas Eve, and the Duke’s friends and family are planning to gather at his mansion for a Christmas party. The gang’s all going to be there: Alice, Rob, Cuff, Zain, and Viola. But when Walter sees Viola depart and decides to tail her…

videos.title: The Duke, Alice, and a Song for Two
videos.overview: Alice struggles with conflicting emotions after she learns from the Duke that he would break ties with his family if his mother doesn’t approve of them getting married after his curse is broken.

videos.title: The Duke and Secret Magic
videos.overview: While searching the main residence, Viola stumbles upon an old servants’ logbook from around the time the Duke got cursed. When she gives it to Alice, Daleth finds out and makes a move to have it destroyed. What is it that Daleth wants kept secret?

videos.title: Together with the Duke...
videos.overview: The Duke's mother summons him to the main residence and gives him an ultimatum. But the Duke has something to tell her as well…

videos.title: The Duke, Alice, and the Magic Pool
videos.overview: On a cold winter's day, Cuff arrives at the mansion with a magic item that can summon a swimming pool from out of nowhere.

videos.title: The Duke, Golf, and the Mysterious Beauty
videos.overview: Alice and the Duke play a game of mini-golf while receiving an unexpected visitor.

videos.title: The Duke, Alice, and the Spectral Bride
videos.overview: The Duke and Alice receive two visitors: a ghost, and a woman who says she can break the curse.

videos.title: The Duke, Alice, and Circus 101
videos.overview: The Duke and Alice join the circus as the Duke prepares to talk to Zain.

videos.title: Cuff, Zain, and the Confession
videos.overview: Zain decides it's time to leave Gemini Circus, but wants to confess his feelings to Cuff before he goes.

videos.title: The Duke and Everyone's Daily Life
videos.overview: The Duke and Alice return to the mansion, bearing gifts from Circus Gemini. Cuff and Zain go out for their first date, but get caught out in the rain.

videos.title: The Duke, Alice, and the Encounter in the Witches' World
videos.overview: Walter, Alice, and the Duke head to the Witches' World to find out more about the curse. Walter has an unexpected encounter.

videos.title: The Duke, Alice, and the Kissing Window
videos.overview: Walter, Alice, and the Duke learn more about the Duke's curse, and the Duke gets a lamp that can grant any wish.

videos.title: The Duke, Alice, and the Second Anniversary
videos.overview: It's been two years since Alice came to the mansion, and the Duke wants to do something special for her.

videos.title: The Duke, Alice, and the Flying Broom
videos.overview: Alice gets a flying broom, and the Duke gets a pair of unusual visitors with a shocking offer.

videos.title: The Duke, Alice, and the Wizardry School
videos.overview: The Duke and all his friends head off to the wizardry school, and Daleth follows as well.

videos.title: The Duke, Alice, and the Curse Witch
videos.overview: Zain takes the crew back in time to confront Sade in the past.

videos.title: The Duke, Alice, and Reuniting with Mom
videos.overview: The Duke, Alice, Cuff, and Zain spend some time at the wizardry school. Meanwhile, Daleth finds someone rather unexpected in the Underworld and takes them to the Duke's mansion.

videos.title: The Duke, Alice, and the Mysterious Clone
videos.overview: Sharon, having been freed from her curse, reunites with her former friends and acquaintances. Unbeknownst to her, Sade hid within her magical clones, bent on attacking anyone who threatens her plans.

videos.title: The Duke, Alice, and Mother and Mother
videos.overview: The Duke catches a cold, and Alice's mother reunites with the Duke's mother after years of separation.

videos.title: The Duke, Alice, and Sade's Love
videos.overview: The Duke and Alice get a very unexpected pair of visitors at the mansion.

videos.title: Dance Party (1)
videos.overview: The Duke and Alice visit the family mansion, where a fancy ball is about to take place.

videos.title: Dance Party (2)
videos.overview: Daleth tells Walter that she wants to become human, and Nico arrives to tell the group that final preparations are complete.

videos.title: Coming Together
videos.overview: The Duke enjoys his last few days before going back into the past to meet Sade.

videos.title: Persuasion
videos.overview: The Duke and his friends go back into the past and try to persuade Sade to break the curse.

videos.title: Loneliness and Uncertainty
videos.overview: The battle with Sade begins in earnest as Zain tries to persuade her to come to the present with them.

videos.title: Victor's Grandson, Sharon's Daughter
videos.overview: Alice goes inside Sade to help heal her loneliness.

videos.title: Friends, a Broken Curse, and Then...
videos.overview: The battle with Sade ends as Alice decides what decision she'll make about her future.

videos.title: The Duke of Death and His Maid
videos.overview: With the curse broken, the Duke, Alice, and everyone else move on to the next stage of their lives.
